test_item:
The trusted root and intermediate certificates shall be stored in a persistent, read-only partition that is isolated from user operations.
(trusted certificate chain is present at the deployed store path)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /odm/etc/cert_store on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /odm/etc/cert_store
er: 1. The adb shell ls -l /odm/etc/cert_store output lists the trusted certificate chain files
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
